Subject: RE: [opensuse] look inside a initrd?

> > > I have been asked by a local company to help debug some appliance that is
> > > booting a image.gz with syslinux. It is loaded from CF in a ramdisk an
> > > then runs without harddisk.
> > > All I have is a image.gz.
-----snip-----
> BTW, is it also possible to unpack, add aditional modules, and run
> mkinitrd again?
> It seems that the 10.3-installation-initrd is missing some modules..

Just edit /etc/sysconfig/kernel and add the appropriate modules, and run mkinitrd again.
